title: Olé
text:
This flamenco show was simply incredible, beautiful, and of rare intensity. You could feel a real connection between the musicians and the dancers, which made the performance even more authentic and touching.
The venue is also very pleasant: since you are seated very close to the stage, you feel every vibration, every step, and all the intensity of the show up close. An immersive experience that I highly recommend! 💃🏽🔥
author: Flyer29819276764

title: Superb show!
text: Ask to be seated at the top, only a few seats 😉😉
author: Lacombre

title: Beautiful, authentic flamenco
text: What a beautiful and intimate venue. Staff were welcoming and friendly. The flamenco was incredible, we could have stayed and watched another show. We cannot recommend this highly enough. The artists were so very talented and it was authentic. Do not hesitate to book ❤️

title: An unforgettable moment to the rhythm of enchanting flamenco!
text:
A very high-quality show! 
Absolutely fantastic.

author: whocaresnicole

title: Really good
text: Such drama passion and energy. All the performers really threw themselves into the performance. Although it was probably their second or third show of the day it felt fresh and unstaged.
author: Jo W

title: Excellent Flamenco Show. Just dancing, singing and music. And you are really close!
text:
Excellent show. No dinner, no drinks…nothing to take away from the dancing and performances. It is a staged performance and you are very close to the stage. You can see and feel the emotion that all of the performers have as they dance, sing and play guitar. Just such a wonderful art. To me, it is almost like fireworks going off, and building to the finales which are always spectacular.
